isAvailable.description: The user lets the agent use this computer and granted the permissions it needs

ref.description: Acts as a window covering the whole screen, for points outside windows

ComputerImage.description: Points in targets are pixels of the window's latest full image, not of a zoom

nodes.description: The window's elements in tree order

isTruncated.description: Elements were left out to keep the view small

ref.description: Present when the element can be acted on

role.description: Lowercase words, such as button or text field

isStale.description: The target element no longer matched; nothing was done and view shows the window

clipboard.description: What the clipboard holds, when it was read

region.description: Zoom: show this part of the window's last image at full resolution

ComputerTarget.description: An element, a whole window, or a point on a window's image

ComputerClipboardParams.description: Writes text or a file when one is given; reads otherwise

installationId.description: Made once per app install and kept on the device only, never backed up

avatarId.description: Load the picture with getAgentAvatar; the id changes when the picture does

files.description: Files the user sent with the message, in order

connect.description: Services the agent asked the user to connect; show a button for each

steps.description: What the agent did on the user's computers, one short line each, in order

Message.description: The newest message people can see

mediaType.description: Pick how to show the file from this; any type may appear

isCurrent.description: True for the device that made this request

requestBody.description: Where to send the sign-in code
The emailed code, and the device signing in

200.description: Signed in. Apps use the token as a bearer token; browsers also get a session cookie and should ignore the token

204.description: Signed out; the token no longer works

requestBody.description: Profile fields to change; the time zone is an IANA name

200.description: The user's agents, the one with the newest message first

201.description: The new agent, with no messages yet

200.description: The whole agent list, as listAgents returns it, now and after every change

requestBody.description: The fields to change, at least one

200.description: The agent as it is now

204.description: Deleted, with its conversation and files

requestBody.description: A square JPEG or PNG, up to 1 MB

200.description: The agent with its new picture

400.description: Invalid request, not a JPEG or PNG, or too large

200.description: The picture; its bytes never change, so cache it by id

404.description: No such agent, or not its current picture

200.description: A page of messages, oldest first

requestBody.description: The user's message: text, files, or both

files.description: Ids from uploadFile, in the order to show them

202.description: Queued; the reply arrives on the event stream

400.description: Invalid request, or a file that is not an upload to this agent

requestBody.description: The file and its name; the server tells its type from the bytes and the name

201.description: Stored; send its id with a message within a day or it is deleted

400.description: Invalid request, an unsupported type, or a file too large

200.description: The file; its bytes never change, so cache it by id

requestBody.description: A recording, M4A or WebM, up to 25 MB; the server keeps none of it

200.description: What was said; empty when nothing was

400.description: Invalid request, or not an M4A or WebM recording

502.description: The recording could not be transcribed

requestBody.description: A voice call with the agent; requests and replies land in the conversation

201.description: The call is ready; audio flows once the answer is set. Close the connection to hang up

502.description: The call could not be started

Every integration the user can connect, with the accounts already connected
The service's logo on a white square

404.description: No such integration or no logo

agentId.description: The agent whose conversation showed the button; it continues once connected

200.description: Open this in a web authentication session; it ends at goat://connected with state and code for createConnection

requestBody.description: The state and code from goat://connected

404.description: No such attempt: it expired, finished already, or another user started it

502.description: The service did not complete the sign-in

302.description: Back to the app at goat://connected?integration=<id>&state=…&code=…, or with error=denied|expired|failed

204.description: Disconnected; the service was asked to revoke the token where it can

200.description: Devices signed in to the account

204.description: Removed; the device is signed out

get.description: Upgrades to a WebSocket that carries JSON-RPC 2.0. The server sends requests (`RpcRequest`), and the device answers each with an `RpcResponse` carrying the same id. Sign in with a `device` first.

409.description: The session was not signed in from a device
